Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::enterItem(barcode: Integer,quantity: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(o|o.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentSale.isComplete<>true and
		item.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		item.StockNumber>0
	postcondition:
		let newLine: SalesLineItem in
		newLine.oclIsNew() and
		SalesLineItem.allInstance()->includes(newLine) and
		CurrentSale.ContainedSalesLine->includes(newLine) and
		newLine.BelongedSale = CurrentSale and
		newLine.Quantity = quantity and
		item.StockNumber = item.StockNumber-quantity and
		newLine.Subamount = item.Price*quantity and
		result = true
}
